finalCompleteComparison.head: 55f49aa7ee34b73935bd69007efe81cb4a93a705
finalCompleteComparison.observation: The collector waits 2.1 seconds outside timed preparation and command batches before endpoint counters. These are quiescent observations, not peaks or atomic snapshots. The first complete run remains retained.

conclusions: The new benefit is sharing common dependencies across distinct workspace templates. Identical templates already shared their tree before recipes.
At 50 workspaces, imported tar bytes fall from 211968000 to 4741120; dependency cache residency falls from 209715200 to 4194304 bytes with 3200 versus 64 physical file identities.
Preparation takes 7.644/7.228 seconds for monolithic imports and 3.215/3.027 seconds for recipes. A single workspace has no preparation benefit in these runs.
Reads copy up zero files. Writing one byte into each dependency copies up 209715200 bytes in both 50-workspace cases; write-tail improvement is inconsistent across repetitions.
This fixed 4 MiB synthetic dependency corpus and burst reader workload does not establish large-environment storage dominance or W0 think-time capacity.
